name: Routing — APIM fronting non-OpenAI (Anthropic, DeepSeek, …)
summary: ApiManagement (AI Gateway v2) connection routing directly to non-OpenAI providers — no custom translation policy required.
description: An `ApiManagement` AI Gateway connection can route `{connection}/{deployment}` from a `PromptAgentDefinition.model` to non-OpenAI providers such as Anthropic Claude and DeepSeek through APIM's provider-native gateway. This lets users keep the Foundry agent surface while the upstream model is hosted outside Azure OpenAI.
notes:
Verified end-to-end through APIM to Anthropic/DeepSeek-style provider backends. See `test.py`.

No OpenAI-to-Anthropic translation policy is needed because APIM AI Gateway speaks the provider API natively. This is separate from `routing-modelgateway-non-openai`; set `AI_GATEWAY_CONNECTION_ANTHROPIC` to run the provider-specific probe.
